inputs.step:
notify:
  name: Post the summary to Slack
  purpose: Posts the summary text to the team's Slack channel through its incoming webhook and returns the response status.
  in:
    summary: inputs.summary
  do:
    kind: run
    runtime: python
    entrypoint: notify.py
  out:
    status:
      type: number
      description: The HTTP status of the post.
inputs.script:
import json, sys, requests
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
response = requests.post("https://hooks.slack.com/services/T000/B000/XXXX", json={"text": data["summary"]}, timeout=20)
print(json.dumps({"status": response.status_code}))

inputs.script:
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
target = "/Volumes/TeamDrive/Reports/weekly-report.md"
with open("/Volumes/TeamDrive/Reports/weekly-report.md", "w") as f:
    f.write(data["report"])
